nodes.title: CORE - START HERE
widgets_values:
CORE - H3 SEAMLESS CHAIN (no extra packs needed)

This variant uses ONLY this node pack and stock ComfyUI nodes. Type your
shots into the sampler's script box, one prompt per shot with --- on its
own line between them, and queue once. Each shot's last frame becomes the
next shot's first frame, the duplicate boundary frame is trimmed, and the
seam audio is welded at the quietest gap so words are not clipped.

Everything lands as one master video plus a matching audio file in
output/video/H3CHAIN/.

RECIPE (shipped, render-verified): fl2va checkpoint, euler + beta57,
14 steps, 243 frames per shot (~10.1s at 24fps). Keep the mux at 24fps -
other rates audibly shift voice accents.

WRITING RULES FOR CLEAN JOINS
- Every shot after the first OPENS holding the previous shot's exact
  closing arrangement, with about two quiet seconds (a breath, a small
  weight shift) before anyone speaks.
- Every shot ENDS settled, dialogue finished, ~2 seconds spare.
- A spoken line never straddles two shots.
- Repeat each character's appearance AND the room/lighting description
  word-for-word in every shot - that verbatim repetition is what holds
  identity, together with the frame relay.

Want the LLM prompt writer, raw-latent context pinning, and the VRAM
panel? Use H3_Seamless_Chain_v1.json and install the optional packs
listed in INSTALL.md.

h3_widget_values.script:
A static camera sits at the end of the table and frames both of them from the chest up in a two-shot; the framing never changes. Live-action, shallow depth of field, fine 35mm grain. A man in his fifties with close-cropped grey hair, deep lines around the eyes and a heavy salt-and-pepper moustache, wearing a faded blue mechanic's jacket over a white t-shirt sits on one side of a late-night roadside diner booth: cracked red vinyl seats, a scratched formica table with two chipped white coffee mugs and a steel napkin dispenser, a rain-streaked window behind them reflecting an empty parking lot, and one warm pendant lamp directly above the table as the only light, the rest of the diner falling away into darkness. Across from him sits a woman in her late twenties with dark curly hair tied back, round wire-frame glasses and chipped green nail polish, wearing an oversized cream cable-knit sweater. He leans forward on his forearms, turning his mug slowly on the table, and the man in the faded blue mechanic's jacket says, "So let me get this straight. The whole street goes dark for six minutes - traffic lights, the gas station, everything - and your shop keeps its lights on." He settles back against the vinyl with both hands around his mug and waits, watching her.

nodes.title: SAMPLER
widgets_values:
SAMPLER

script: one prompt per shot, --- on its own line between shots.
  JSON {"prompts": [...]} is also accepted.
shot_count: 0 = one shot per prompt; 1-8 forces the count.
size / frames / steps: driven by MASTER CONTROLS.
sampler + scheduler: set here (euler + beta57 = the verified pair).
seed_per_shot [ON]: leave it on - measured, per-shot seeds HOLD the
  face; a single seed for every shot drifted both face and voice.
chain_gain_control: set to 'flatten' for chains past about 5 shots -
  texture ratchets roughly 1.3x per join otherwise.
self_anchor_voice: pins shot 1's own voice into later shots. Needs a
  ref2va checkpoint; leave off on fl2va.
preview_first_shot [ON]: writes shot 1 as soon as it decodes so a bad
  take can be cancelled before the whole chain renders.
